_comment: Single source of truth for the URL the NATIVE APP SHELLS (iOS / Android / Electron) load. This is the app container only — NOT customer-facing links (invoices, proposals, emails), which stay per-tenant / treemarkables. To change it: edit `host` below, run `node scripts/sync-app-shell-url.mjs`, then rebuild each shell. See DESKTOP_BUILD_GUIDE.md / ANDROID_BUILD_GUIDE.md.
